how_to_apply: Download the application form from the official website www.ksmha.org.
Fill in all required details in the application form accurately.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates and documents proving age, educational qualifications, experience, degree, post graduation, and medical council registration.
Attach your Curriculum Vitae (CV) and a separate sheet describing your experience in the field of Mental Health if required.
Place the application and documents inside an envelope.
Superscribe the envelope as “Application for the appointment of Member of the Mental Health Review Board, Kannur”.
Submit the application by post or by hand to the Chief Executive Officer, Keralam State Mental Health Authority, Red Cross Road, Trivandrum – 695 035 on or before 23.10.2026 before 5.15 PM.
important_instructions: A person shall be disqualified to be appointed as a member if convicted and sentenced to imprisonment for an offence involving moral turpitude, adjudged as an insolvent, removed or dismissed from Government service or a body corporate owned/controlled by Government, or has financial/other interest prejudicial to the functions of a member. Members holding any full-time or part-time assignment preventing adequate time and attention, or holding any office in a political party during tenure, shall stand disqualified. The member shall hold office for a term of five years or up to the age of seventy years, whichever is earlier, and is eligible for reappointment for another term of five years or up to seventy years of age. Applications received after 23.10.2026 (5.15 PM) will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is KSMHA Member - Medical Practitioner Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment notification issued by the Keralam State Mental Health Authority to appoint 1 Member - Medical Practitioner for the Mental Health Review Board in Kannur.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Member - Medical Practitioner post in Kannur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 23 October 2026 before 5.15 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The candidate must possess qualifications as per Section 2(1)(n) of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The member of the Board shall hold office up to the age of seventy years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply offline by submitting the filled application form along with self-attested copies of documents to the Chief Executive Officer, Keralam State Mental Health Authority, Trivandrum.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The appointment is made by the Chairperson of the State Authority from eligible applicants possessing the requisite qualifications.

faq.question: Q9. What is the honorarium for serving government medical practitioners?
faq.answer: Serving Government Medical Practitioners receive an honorarium of Rs. 2,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. Can retired government medical practitioners apply?
faq.answer: Yes, retired Government Medical Practitioners can apply, and their honorarium is limited to Rs. 50,000/- (Last pay minus pension before commutation).
